chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم was asked how the Angel of Death takes the believer, so he said:

Indeed, the Angel of Death stands before the believer at the time of his death like a humble servant before his master. He and his companions do not come near him until he first greets him with peace and gives him glad tidings of Paradise.

key_terms.التَّسْلِيمِ: greeting with peace before taking the soul
key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise, the glad tidings given to the believer
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِ: the believer, the person characterized by faith
key_terms.مَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ: the Angel of Death, who takes souls at the time of death
key_terms.مَوْتِهِ: his death, the moment of departing from worldly life

ai.seo_question: How does the Angel of Death take the soul of a believer according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the dignity and gentleness granted to the believer at the moment of death. It portrays the Angel of Death as approaching with humility, peace, and glad tidings of Paradise, emphasizing the believer’s honored state in the transition to the afterlife.
